mode: Built-in image_gen: generate, with outline-only edits for vector and twin

vector.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production decorative technical line drawing for a motor engineering desktop app, 1536x1024 landscape. Monochrome ONLY: fine neutral light gray lines on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Absolutely NO color, no cyan, no copper orange, no gradients, no glow, no photorealistic lighting, no solid shaded areas, no dark photographic backdrop, no text, no labels, no numbers, no annotations, no dimension arrows, no dense grid. Elegant restrained mechanical CAD hidden-line illustration with sparse crisp contours, a few inner construction lines and light section hatching. Subject centered across the canvas, occupies 80 percent width and 75 percent height with generous margins. No separate panels. Clear mechanical structure, uncluttered, suitable as a very faint background watermark behind controls. Subject: front orthographic section view of an electric motor, concentric rotor and stator, evenly spaced stator slots, simplified winding loops, rotor center shaft and bearing rings. Precisely radial symmetric geometry. No vectors or charts.
vector.edit_prompt: Use case: background-extraction / style-transfer. Edit this motor technical drawing into PURE OUTLINE-ONLY drafting artwork. Preserve camera view and mechanical shape. Remove ALL filled faces, ALL white interiors, ALL shaded areas, all glow and background. Make all enclosed regions, spaces between lines and exterior background genuinely alpha=0 TRANSPARENT. ONLY thin neutral silver gray contour strokes should remain, like a wire CAD exported with fill=none. No solid motor silhouette or white paper! Light gray line strokes, no color, no text. PNG real transparency. Sparse crisp contours suitable to overlay as faint structure lines on a dark app background. Lines must be visible but NO FILL anywhere.
